case.title: One second before 21:00 with a long interview that runs past 21:00

submissions.open_text: The hand pump near the school broke last week and repairs are slow.
We buy jerricans from a handcart seller because the pipes are dry.

case.why: 20:59:59+03:00 is one second before the inclusive 21:00 threshold, so off_hours must not fire. Two wrong implementations would fire here. One rounds or truncates to minutes and then compares with >= 21:00. The other uses the interview end time: captured_at plus 1380 s is 21:22:59. The rule says only captured_at counts. Other checks are quiet. Inside Nyalenda (lng 34.74-34.76, lat -0.11 to -0.09): (-0.100, 34.750) and (-0.105, 34.745). Duration is at least 720 s. Only one other submission that day, and only 2 submissions in total. No word overlap between the texts, and no voice note.
